# Fixtures

Use redistributable, consented or synthetic fixtures only. Never commit personal production dictation/audio. Document source/license for every media fixture.

`jfk16.wav` is the canonical 16 kHz mono PCM sample distributed by
`ggerganov/whisper.cpp` at commit
`5670d5c0bbcb148feabef84400a07cfca9aa3b30`. The upstream repository is MIT
licensed. Narrivy pins the exact file as SHA-256
`59dfb9a4acb36fe2a2affc14bacbee2920ff435cb13cc314a08c13f66ba7860e` and uses
it only for the audible native known-phrase qualification.
